Layla Rose Ranch is a nonprofit organization  5013c. 
It all started with Cletus my heart horse and because of him I have found my calling. We rescue horses and help them trust again so they can have forever homes. It breaks my heart seeing these horses come in in poor shape, non trusting and depressed. They count on us to help them because they don’t have a voice so we have to be a voice for them. Please follow us and share and help us help them. Donations can be made on our website Laylaroseranch.org 

We can also be found on Facebook and Tik Tok
